|errata_mark=
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[I Am Part Of The Living Force]] (version 1 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published (3 September 2021). The current text is [[I Am Part Of The Living Force (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/iampartofthelivingforce.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/iampartofthelivingforce.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-o">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1a519d514de0c15525458580c14f6b792a14c46a swccg-card-json commit 1a519d514d] (4 September 2021): dating evidence only.</ref>: “If your starting location had 'communing' in game text, deploy Communing and stack a Jedi with 'communing' in game text on it. Deploy up to three Effects that deploy on table and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” No E mark. Margin: “A Tremor In The Force”. The image prints curly double quotes around “communing”.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I Am Part Of The Living Force (Errata)]]): PC re-rendering of the Virtual Set 16 images; card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/iampartofthelivingforce.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/iampartofthelivingforce.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If your starting location had 'communing' in game text, deploy Communing and stack a Jedi with 'communing' in game text on it. Deploy up to three Effects that deploy on table and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” Same game text words as the original; no E mark. The PC published a second, pixel-identical copy of this image on 5 July 2022 (format conversion only, no visible change).<ref name="img-rr7">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/iampartofthelivingforce.gif</code> as published 5 July 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/iampartofthelivingforce.gif holotable commit a41bae9] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref> '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image: the side copyright line changed from “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” to “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, the artist credit line was reset (e.g. “ArtStation.com” → “ArtStation” on Grogu), and the game text was re-typeset (new line breaks). A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[I Am Part Of The Living Force (Errata 2)]]): PC errata of 12 December 2022; card image marked E1 published 12 December 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/iampartofthelivingforce.gif</code> as published 12 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/iampartofthelivingforce.gif holotable commit 12d0bca] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E2">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/f434d313352448d45db14e080230103c086b1276 swccg-card-json commit f434d31335] (12 December 2022): dating evidence only.</ref>: “If your starting location had 'communing' in game text, deploy Communing and stack a Jedi with 'communing' in game text on it. Deploy up to three Effects that deploy on table, deploy for free, and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 12 December 2022): “Original card did not require the Effects to deploy for free, which meant the original could start We're Leaving.” The card prints “E1”; it is the second change counted here, so its version code is PC-E2. '''What changed:''' “deploy for free,” was added: the three Effects must now be ones that “deploy on table, deploy for free, and are always immune to Alter”. The card gained the E1 mark (printed).
